profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced full-stack software developer with 20 years of success delivering maintainable, software-mediated solutions across web and enterprise environments. With a focus on C#, .NET, and modern JavaScript frameworks like Angular and Node.js, Paul brings a pragmatic and analytical approach to problem-solving and process improvement. He is comfortable providing technical leadership and mentoring teammates, while remaining eager to learn from others and grow alongside a team. Seeking a technically engaging role that supports collaboration, continuous learning, and the thoughtful use of AI tools to improve quality and productivity.

positions.title: Chief Visionary Officer
positions.description:
• Developed an agent to monitor availability and prices of in-demand products on e-commerce web sites.  When a product was found to be in stock (and optionally below a configured price), it would trigger a mobile device notification to alert me.  I used this to successfully acquire a PlayStation 5, an Xbox Series X, and other products during periods of high demand.
• Developed a utility (using NAudio and my .NET HID class lib) to control playback of audio recordings of oral family histories for the purposes of facilitating accurate audio transcription.
• Developed a browser-based multidimensional javascript-based data visualization application (using dc.js, crossfilter, and d3.js).
• Developed a .NET Human Interface Device class library for (32-bit or 64-bit) Windows.  Using this, I developed some device-specific libraries for various other input hardware (including the Nintendo Wii remote, the 3DConnexion SpaceNavigator, and the Microsoft Xbox 360 controller).
• Developed a browser-based Mandelbrot set explorer using canvas and JavaScript web workers for background calculations.
• Developed web application using Google Maps to show the locations of church members with additional member data.

positions.title: Lead Technical Consultant
positions.description:
Client #3: Multinational Investment Bank and Financial Services Company
Role: Web Services API Developer (July 2022 – July 2024)

Developed features for consumer-facing wealth management web applications.

• Developed a web service API (Java) for managing external client financial accounts. 
• Developed a shared .NET component for producing PDF and Excel report exports. 
• Technologies: Visual Studio, .NET Core, NUnit, IntelliJ IDEA, Java, Maven, JUnit, Mockito.


Client #2: Multinational Healthcare Services Company
Role: Data Integrations Developer (Aug 2021 – May 2022)

Supported efforts to migrate client data files and ensure the quality of migrated relational data.

• Led a team focused on data validation initiatives to ensure the quality and consistency of migrated data and new application outputs.
• Developed a PowerShell module to facilitate Dataverse web API operations.
• Developed various data integration solutions involving SharePoint and Dataverse.
• Technologies: Visual Studio Code, SSMS, PowerShell, SQL, Dataverse Web API, SharePoint PnP PowerShell, SharePoint Online, Power Query.


Client #1: Large National Non-profit Health System
Role: Full-stack Developer (Feb 2021 – Aug 2021)

Built new features for a patient appointment pre-visit registration single-page web application hosted on Microsoft Azure.

• Contributed to the software development lifecycle, from initial requirements analysis and prototyping to automated testing and documentation.
• Led efforts to standardize and ensure consistency of visual design, including contributing to the client's shared Angular component library.
• Established an Azure CI pipeline for mutation testing, improving the quality and coverage of automated unit tests.
• Technologies: C#, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, xUnit, SQL Server, Node.js, TypeScript, Angular, Jasmine, Protractor, Microsoft Azure.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Contributed to various projects/features pertaining to the core HRM SAAS product (e.g. data import, data purging, app settings, web API development, support tools, rules-driven service-level agreements).  Development efforts focused back-end work but also included some front-end work (i.e. requirements gathering, domain and data modeling, implementation, [unit / integration / UI] testing, code reviews, etc.)
• Developed web UI for visualizing and exploring complex temporal data using d3.js.  This significantly facilitated investigations into issues pertaining to that data and their subsequent resolution.
• Developed an event-sourcing-based algorithm (with periodic snapshots and support for derived events) to track state changes to domain entities over time and to enable calculating time accrued with respect to dynamic schedule parameters.
• Developed testing framework to facilitate development of integration tests (primarily of back-end services) and to simulate/reproduce some complex scenarios involving production services performing concurrent operations.  This greatly simplified test generation and enable reliable reproduction of some rather elusive race conditions and deadlocks.

Development environment (not comprehensive):
• Languages/Frameworks:  C# (ASP.Net Web API, .NET Core, StructureMap, NHibernate), JavaScript (Node.js, d3.js, jQuery), SQL
• Tools:  Visual Studio / VS Code, Sql Server, MySql, GitHub, Reviewable.io, TeamCity.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Contributed to various projects targeting features of the core technology platform.
• Significantly improved our internal web-based real-time operational reporting application (including making enhancements and addressing scalability issues), enabling a more responsive experience for a larger audience.
• Created and supported tools for simplifying tasks by account managers: making bulk changes to account data, updating customer subsidy eligibility info, supporting traffic affiliate requests for new tracking pixels.
• Created and supported tools for automating tedious operational tasks: integrating with SalesForce to synchronize customer data, performing annual product pricing changes, periodic data updates from 3rd-party vendors, archiving log files, deploying configuration files, archiving/pruning historical data from databases.
• Assumed responsibility for oversight/maintenance of Splunk installation for gaining operational insights from machine-generated data (log files). Created alerts to detect critical/important operational issues. Created dashboards for viewing data to detect trends at a glance.
• Regularly contributed documentation about processes, platform features, configuration, etc.
• Maintained and improved internal bid management tools.  Converted Windows Forms app to WPF and made significant enhancements to it.  Built MDX parser-generator.  

Development environment (not comprehensive):
• .NET Framework 4.0, ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Web API, C#, Javascript, JSON web services, jQuery, regular expressions, NUnit, NHibernate, Json.NET, ANTLR, log4net, WCF, WPF, Python
• Development infrastructure and automation:  TeamCity, Subversion, Windows Powershell, NAnt, JIRA, Confluence
• Data stuff:  MySQL, MS SQL Server (T-SQL), MDX, Splunk
• Other tools: NDepend, LINQPad

positions.title: C# .NET Developer
positions.description:
• Contributed to the development of Lamar's first RESTful SOA enterprise web application (used to reserve and book all of Lamar's inventory) using ASP.NET MVC service layer (using JSON and AJAX) and an MVC-based web front-end  JavaScript (using Ext JS and Prototype).  Developed using Agile methods, TDD, and continuous integration practices (using NUnit and CruiseControl.NET respectively) and 3-week development cycles, helping to ensure frequent, high-quality releases for our users with minimal defects. 
• Developed a C# framework for effectively altering test parameters of an NUnit test suite at run-time, making it possible to test under a variety of conditions without recompiling.  WCF was used to enable communication between the NUnit test process (i.e. the client) and a separate WinForms server process which provided the user-configurable test conditions.
• Developed an API abstraction layer for web-based map providers (including Google’s Maps JS API and ESRI’s ArcGIS JS API) to facilitate the interchanging of map provider.  Supporting a uniform navigation API and a custom marker layer, this API was subsequently used in two enterprise systems to show the location of outdoor inventory.
• Used Windows Workflow Foundation and C# to re-write a service used to process MSMQ messages in support of Lamar’s near real-time data warehouse, so the service could be more easily modified by non-technical personnel.
• Developed a C# API for rendering HTML reports which would display virtually identically across MSIE, Firefox, and Chrome we browsers.  It could be declaratively used in a highly compact and expressive form using C# object initializers.
• Responsibilities included analysis, design, estimation, GUI prototyping, coding (C# and Javascript), testing (unit, integration, & regression), communicating with end users, overseeing/enforcing standards for GUI architecture, and identifying opportunities to improve the user experience.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET · Defect Tracking · Databases · RESTful WebServices · Data Modeling · ASP.NET · Creative Problem Solving · Integration Testing · Web Services · Teamwork · Communication · Microsoft SQL Server · WCF · C# · NUnit · Programming · Unit Testing · Ext JS

positions.title: .NET Software Developer / Consultant
positions.description:
• Developed a numerical & logical evaluation framework in C# allowing arbitrarily complex formulas to be easily composed by chaining together formula units, facilitating automatic run-time re-evaluations as needed. This greatly simplified the process of keeping financial calculations in sync. 
• Developed code-generation utility to streamline production of data access code.  Used database schema to generate VB.NET classes and SQL Server stored procedures.  Using this tool, when database structure changes occurred, corresponding class updates could be made more than 10 times as efficiently as before and were consistently defect-free.
• Developed .NET data access framework in C# (with ADO.NET) which used reflection and .NET attributes on members of business object classes to perform SQL Server database operations on those objects.  This eliminated the need to update data access code to account for database schema changes.
• Developed a C# Windows forms application (backed by a SQL Server db) for the Louisiana Tax Commission to record particular financials of Louisiana public utility companies, calculate/assess property taxes owed, and produce annual and historical reports (with SSRS).  This application centralized data storage and automated many manual processes, greatly simplifying what was being managed beforehand using many Excel files.

positions.title: Application Developer II
positions.description:
• Contributed to the analysis, design, coding, testing, and documentation of components of an enterprise multi-tiered ASP.NET / C# / SQL Server loan origination application as a member and leader of various development teams.
• Developed the first formal, segregated development, testing, and staging environments and processes for flagship products, subsequently adopted by the development, QA, and hosting services teams.
• Developed a new framework for largely automating the build processes of an enterprise web application for QA and development departments and trained others to do the same.   Resulting process required less than %5 of prior effort.
• Designed an application to support the scheduling and automated, recurring delivery of Crystal reports.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET · Defect Tracking · Databases · ASP.NET · Creative Problem Solving · Teamwork · Communication · Microsoft SQL Server · C# · Programming

positions.title: Scientific Visualization Application Developer
positions.description:
• Participated as a contributing member of an interdisciplinary research group, including steering scientific research, developing custom data processing or visualization applications, and contributing to published research papers.
• Developed a cross-platform, 3D particle visualization system for exploring/analyzing large scientific and medical data sets (up to ~1 billion data points, ~10GB) at interactive speeds (>10 fps), thus facilitating materials science research by increasing the responsiveness of visual analysis by up to 50 times of what was possible previously.
• Developed a novel occlusion culling algorithm for optimized visualization of discrete particles and co-authored a research paper that outlines this work which was presented at the IEEE Virtual Reality 2002 conference.
• Developed a framework upon which to create animations with charted paths through 3-D scenes which could be significantly automated by researchers.
positions.insights: Skills: Data Visualization · Creative Problem Solving · OpenGL · Communication · Interactive Data Visualization · Programming
